children: The 187th meeting of the State Level Bankers’ Committee (SLBC), Tamil Nadu, was recently held at Chennai, to review the performance of the banking sector as of June 2026 in the State. The meeting also deliberated upon various issues relating to credit flow, financial inclusion and implementation of government-sponsored schemes.

The meeting was attended by M  A  Siddique, IAS, Additional Chief Secretary (Finance), Government of Tamil Nadu; Dhanaraj T, Executive Director, Indian Overseas Bank & Chairman, SLBC Tamil Nadu; Y  Jayakumar, Regional Director, Reserve Bank of India, Chennai; and H Manoj, Chief General Manager, NABARD, Tamil Nadu.

Various HODs from GoTN including secretaries and commissioners of various departments, senior officials of the government, Reserve Bank of India and NABARD, senior executives of member banks and Lead District Managers (LDMs) from across the State attended the meeting.
During the special address Additional Chief Secretary (Finance), emphasised that the special focus to be given to disburse more KCC, KCC dairy loans, Agri Infrastructure, Food Processing loans etc.

He also emphasised that under MSME, various model project to be created for the benefit of new entrepreneurs and necessary guidance and handholding support to be extended by banks and concerned department.
Velayutham K, General Manager, Indian Overseas Bank and Convenor, SLBC Tamil Nadu, presented the agenda and facilitated the deliberations on the various agenda items.

The meeting reviewed the overall performance of banks in Tamil Nadu, with particular focus on credit flow to priority sectors and the progress under various government-sponsored and financial inclusion schemes. The performance of banks in areas including Agriculture and Allied Activities, Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs), education loans, housing and other priority sectors was reviewed.

The meeting provided a platform for constructive interaction among Government Departments, regulatory and developmental institutions, banks and Lead District Managers, with a view to addressing operational issues and strengthening the banking ecosystem in Tamil Nadu, the SLBC said in a statement.

title: Officials discuss credit ecosystem of TN in 187th State Level Bankers’ Committee (SLBC) meet
